specs.quote: Bambu Lab AMS 2 Pro | Bambu Bus Cable-4Pin | Switching Adapter | Filament Buffer (Only Included with 'Combo with buffer') | AMS Hub (Only Included with 'Combo with hub') | … PTFE Tube Coupler
specs.note: Add-ons only. The wiki names two AMS 2 Pro combo kinds (with buffer / with hub); the store sells one "P1S AMS 2 Pro Combo".
